answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 28358 Country: India Title: Respected pious scholar,Is my name kaynat shamsi fine or should change my name? Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu!! Respected pious scholar,Is my name kaynat shamsi fine or should change my name?? Answer ID: 28358 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 50/50/M=1432) The said name though is not wrong according to the meaning, you may keep this name, but it is not a good name. If you do not feel any problem, you should change it with a good name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
